issues.detail: The Hebrew place name is יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד (Jabesh-gilead), but the Chinese renders it as '約別士人的基列居民' (the Gilead inhabitants of the people of Yabesh?). The name '約別士' appears to be a garbled or incorrect rendering of 'Jabesh' (יָבֵשׁ), and the phrase '基列居民' (Gilead inhabitants) misplaces the construct relationship: the Hebrew means 'the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead' (יֹשְׁבֵי יָבֵשׁ גִּלְעָד), not 'Gilead inhabitants of the people of Yabesh'. This changes the identity of the target.
